source_title: SOUTHWEST AIRLINES ANNOUNCES PRICING OF NOTES - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
DALLAS , Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE: LUV ) (the "Company") today announced that it has priced an underwritten public offering of $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its senior notes, consisting of $600,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.750% Notes due 2029 (the "2029 Notes") and $650,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.000% Notes due 2031 (the "2031 Notes" and, collectively with the 2029 Notes, the "Notes").
The Company expects to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, which may include, but are not limited to, the repayment at maturity of all of the Company's outstanding $300 million aggregate principal amount of 3.000% notes due November 15, 2026, as well as the repayment or redemption of other indebtedness or other corporate obligations. The offering is expected to close on or about November 2, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Barclays Capital Inc., BNP Paribas Securities Corp., Standard Chartered Bank, U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc., and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering. A shelf registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") and has become effective. The offering may be made only by means of a prospectus supplement and an accompanying base prospectus. The preliminary prospectus supplement and accompanying base prospectus relating to the offering have been filed, and a final prospectus supplement will be filed, with the SEC and will be available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov . About Southwest Airlines Co. Southwest Airlines Co. operates Southwest Airlines, a major passenger airline that provides scheduled air transportation in the United States and near-international markets. We commenced service on June 18, 1971, with three Boeing 737 aircraft serving three Texas cities: Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio. As of September 30, 2026, we had a total of 803 Boeing 737 aircraft in our fleet and served 120 destinations in the United States and near-international countries.
